title: Affine-local comparison at one level
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme and I an ideal sheaf, with any HasKernels and HasCokernels instances for the coherent formal module category [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. For one affine open U of X, one arrow alpha:F to G, and one n in the natural numbers, the restriction to U of the level n+1 component of the canonical coimage-image comparison is an isomorphism of module sheaves. No abelian structure on the coherent formal category is assumed.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian), last paragraph of the proof of part (1), Coim=Im

proof.text: Use the kernel construction of [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module-kernel] and termwise cokernels supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-cokernel-closure]. Restriction to an affine open preserves these constructions: images, kernels and ideal products restrict, quotient maps restrict by [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], and any enlarged stabilization constant gives the same eventual quotient system. The restricted kernel is thus the system with affine sections $K/I^nK$, where $K=\ker f$ in the affine equivalence [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-affine]. Noetherianity of the completion [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-noetherian] ensures that $K$ is finite. The equivalence similarly identifies the cokernel with $\operatorname{Coker}f$.

Identify coimage and image on the fixed affine with quotient systems of M/ker f and im f. Apply the module first isomorphism theorem, then reduce the inverse modulo J^(n+1) and take its associated sheaf. Transport along the unique kernel and cokernel identifications for arbitrary supplied structures. This is the affine algebraic step only; it neither glues inverses nor asserts a global abelian structure.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentFormalModules_coimageImage_isIso_restrict_affine
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    [HasKernels (CoherentFormalModule X I)]
    [HasCokernels (CoherentFormalModule X I)] (U : X.affineOpens)
    {F G : CoherentFormalModule X I} (α : F ⟶ G) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U : X.Opens).ι).map
      ((Abelian.coimageImageComparison α).hom.app (op n)))
